name: EchoEar step-10 requal-n1: item1 combined + item2 six stages on the merged AEC-off line
release_requirements: One coordinator-frozen normal ELF (binding normal_elf_sha256) for every item2 stage; AEC off verified at boot
The demo (autostart) variant of the same commit is the item1 image; both from master 16c45a3 (no firmware change since 8c84e05)
Normal ELF masked-equal to merge-9d-r4/bundle-mute 3eaa629a (.flash.appdesc only), so mute-03 PASS carries over (decision 134 D2)
fixture/budget/bot/harness hashes frozen in the binding before the first scored prompt
validate embedded ESP app descriptor version, descriptor presence in ELF and bin embedded ELF SHA256; project_description metadata alone is insufficient
heap minimum includes cold boot and task census/PERF allocations; no reset/exclusion or substitution of current free for historical minimum
Smoke runs are never counted; acceptance needs the user's quiet-room go after the smoke, N-1 pause test and pre-mortem
Every item1/item2 hold restores and boot-verifies the 9936da45 restore-of-record bundle before releasing the lock (Astra r1 #2, Fable F3)

Device-reported public profile gated in item1 and every item2 stage: AUDIO_CAPABILITY aec=0, PERF aec block absent, MIC_GAIN_PATH 30 dB/0x1a/125 %, MIC_PROTECTION 1/8192/16384, autostart demo true / normal false, and device-reported setup/cleanup volume state (hil/echoear_image_profile.py; generated config never read). Scored measurement records at output_volume_db 0 in item1 and every item2 stage EXCEPT a6_hot_stt, which is uplink-only and exempt: its volume is recorded, not gated, at the firmware default -6 dB (decision 136).

order.gate: existing unchanged stress gates on frozen bank
existing pair_gate including no WER regression
order.volume_expectation: Decision 136 named exception: uplink-only (Jabra prompt into the board mic, retained uplink scored, no board playback); the harness never commands playback volume, so the device stays at its -6 dB default as its 9bc2d42 PASS of record did. Recorded, not gated. No prior run is rescored.

order.gate: existing measurement validity and nonlinear-growth gates; retain investigation_required; REPORT-ONLY (decision 134 D6)

order.setup_failure: A quiet_live setup failure is unscored and filled by a continuation (decision 134 D6)

record: both measured floors and WAV paths
deferrals.policy: Wait and retry eligibility later; never replay a scored original. If interrupted after scored originals, preserve the incomplete population; a restart is not a new clean cohort. Resume requires proven original peer continuity.

firmware.volume_scope: volume_relative_db applies to the scored playback measurement records only: e2e before_perf/after_perf and reply_window_transport.before/after of every scored original, echo-stress/analog point before/after; item1 samples. Setup (0) and harness cleanup (-6) volumes are validated separately as device-reported state (OUTPUT_VOLUME vs session PERF). Astra r2 #1, Fable B1. a6_hot_stt is exempt (decision 136; order[2].volume_expectation).

strict_gates.uplink_gate: existing uplink_continuity.link_tail defaults unchanged: >60ms rate<=1%, >150ms rate<=0.05%, hard max<=2000ms; coverage required

bot.mode: live-test for strict and quiet-live; offline-test for quiet-offline
bot.strict_reply: existing long Pineapple/France reply; do not shorten

raw_required: full-reply frame clock bracket and wire render proof
Jabra and board room floors before each run
per-arm NIC counters and deferral log

all_originals_policy: Execute all3strict and5perquiet originals with no retakes; ordinary scored failures remainFAIL and continue. Fatal raw/device/setup/cleanup error stops incomplete; onepeer/warm coverage still required. Eligibility deferrals release bench; zero-scored deferrals alone may retry after30s.

derived_from.note: The 10-15 attempt-2 campaign plan (geometry-rebased strict/quiet). Only the fields listed in decision_134 and the image/evidence pins differ.

decision_134.D3_scope: "All six stages": item1 combined proof plus item2 strict_voice_cat 3/3, a6_echo_stress, a6_hot_stt, a6_analog_probe, quiet_offline 5 and quiet_live 5.
decision_134.D4_geometry: "Not moved: re-bind". The user states the bench has not moved since 10-14/15; the −29.85 dBFS ±3 / rise ≥10 dB policy is re-bound to the new normal ELF with no geometry A/B. Cost accepted: an unnoticed move would fail the level gate in acceptance.
decision_134.D5_item1_transport: "Allow ≤1 lost frame". At most 1 lost/concealed/PLC/playout-dropped downlink frame per session, with the RF pre-gate recorded. This reverses the all-zero rule for item1 only; the item2 strict stage's own transport gates are unchanged.
decision_134.D5_implementation: r2 (Astra r1 #3, Fable F1; adopted by decision 135): hil/echoear_item1_combined.py distinct_frame_gate: one distinct affected downlink frame per session, conservative because no retained frame identity proves a late-rejection overlap: concealed == plc_frames <= lost and max(lost, concealed, plc_frames) + playout_dropped <= 1, on the absolute counters of every fresh Session and on the cycle/restart within-session deltas; every other transport counter and mic clip counter 0; 30 s wlp8s0 RF pre-gate before flash recorded as rf-pre-gate.json. The combined-4 1/1/1/1 shape fails this rule (combined-4 stays FAIL of record, not rescored). strict_gates.transport_counter_deltas below is unchanged.
D6_defaults: a quiet_live setup failure is unscored and filled by a continuation
D1_D2_defaults: the restore image is AEC-off without autostart
fresh build from master, with a masked compare against 3eaa629a; if only .flash.appdesc differs, mute-03 PASS carries over
decision_134.acceptance: Acceptance still needs a quiet-room go after the smoke, N-1 pause test and pre-mortem.

D6_implementation.analog_probe: hil/echoear_item2_campaign.py: a6_analog_probe (report_only) keeps its measurement passed/investigation verdict unchanged; the stage exits 0 when the acquisition is valid (points, resources, device profile, NIC, restore), and echoear_requalification.acceptance_verdict excludes its measurement verdict from the acceptance pass.
D6_implementation.quiet_live: hil/echoear_item2_campaign.py aggregate_quiet_live and --continue-from: only the final unscored setup-failure slot of a segment is filled by a continuation in the same stage root; scored originals (including FAILs) are never replaced; no reruns; each segment one peer and warm after its first run; at most 3 segments; the stage passes only when slots 1..5 are all scored and passed and every segment observation gate (except its per-segment exact-original count) passes.

decision_134.D5_decision_135: Decision 135 (user 2026-10-26 ~14:15) refines D5 for item1: "Conservative one-event": concealed == plc_frames <= lost and max(lost, concealed, plc_frames) + playout_dropped <= 1, with every other transport and clip counter at 0, on fresh-session totals and injected/restart deltas. A single late packet (the combined-4 1/1/1/1 shape) still FAILS item1; combined-4 stays FAIL of record and is not rescored. The item2 strict gates are unchanged (all-zero).
decision_134.D_volume_decision_136: Decision 136 (user 2026-10-26): a6_hot_stt volume exempt (recorded, not gated); every other item2 stage and item1 keep 0 dB on scored records. The frozen A6 plan file carries a top-level volume_relative_db 0 written by echoear_acoustic_qualification.prepare(); hot_stt never consumed it. The r5 A6 plan copy adds volume_relative_db_exceptions naming a6_hot_stt (decision 136).
